# Rory's Rooftop

> Rooftop bar and restaurant in NYC's Meatpacking District — craft cocktails, elevated cuisine, and skyline views.

- [Events](/events): Private events and upcoming happenings at the rooftop.
- [Blog](/blog): Stories, cocktail features, and behind-the-scenes posts.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers to common questions about visiting, reservations, and policies.
- [Contact](/contact): Location, hours, phone, email, and inquiry form.
